metadata.task_goal: Establish a documented handoff for dialysis access and prescription information using available transition materials.

DIALYSIS TRANSITION REQUEST
Patient ID: PAT-V3-4901
The receiving dialysis unit requests an access and prescription handoff. Reference: DTH-V3-4901.
files./workspace/ehr/current.txt:
CURRENT DIALYSIS RECORD
Patient ID: PAT-V3-4901
Today's treatment used a left upper-arm graft. The treatment sheet reports arterial pressure alarms during the final hour. Post-treatment weight is 71.8 kg; the listed target weight is 70.5 kg.
files./workspace/ehr/history.txt:
RECENT HISTORY
The prior outpatient record describes a right chest catheter as the active access two weeks ago. A vascular access note from three days ago says the graft was cannulated but gives no durability statement. Interdialytic weight gain at the prior session was 2.7 kg.
files./workspace/ehr/evidence.txt:
RECEIVING-UNIT EVIDENCE
The receiving-unit summary lists a right chest catheter and target weight 71.0 kg. A dialysis prescription draft lists a left graft and target weight 70.5 kg, but it is unsigned. The most recent nephrology note is signed before today's treatment.
